name: Layout A
heading: Layout A: bed facing the pantry, TV on the toilet wall
description: A 3D concept of the 12′0″ × 12′3″ room, pantry and balcony. It uses the things already in your photos (2 single beds, side table, 43-inch TV, small fridge, oven, wall-mounted folding desk) plus your induction stove and top-load washing machine. The walls stay white, and the floor tiles, wardrobe and pantry are left as they are. The only new things are soft furnishings and small accessories.
assumptions: Sizes come from the floor plan (room 3.66 × 3.745 m, pantry 1.73 × 1.80 m, balcony 2.65 × 0.91 m). Furniture sizes are estimated from the photos.

The TV moves from the left wall to the toilet wall, facing the bed. Re-use the same bracket. The old screw holes on the left wall can be filled with white wall putty, no repainting needed. The black plastic chair from the photos is used at the desk.
The fridge and oven rack sits where the counter ends, near the counter plug points. Plug the oven and fridge into separate sockets, and the induction into its own 16A socket.
The split AC, its outdoor unit and the RO purifier are drawn where they are in your photos. The outdoor unit sits on brackets above the washing machine, so leave about 20 cm of air gap between them.
The washing machine needs a socket, a water tap and a drain point on the balcony’s right side. If the tap or drain is on the left side, swap the machine with the plants.
The wardrobe is freestanding, so it only needs to slide about 50 cm toward the window. Empty it before moving it.
The two single beds are joined into one double, with a double comforter over both. Add a mattress joiner strip so the gap in the middle doesn’t sag. You can still split them for two guests.

Finish swatches show how the furniture would look with a new laminate or wrap. Pick one for all furniture, or mix them per item. Coloured finishes are shown as matte laminates. The real furniture stays walnut unless you re-laminate it.

placements.placement: Your 2 single beds pushed together, headboards against the wall opposite the pantry, with a double comforter over both
placements.why: Feels like a proper double for couples. The left side stays open as the walkway from the entrance

placements.placement: Moved to the toilet wall, straight in front of the bed, with a floating shelf under it
placements.why: About 3.5 m from the bed, a comfortable distance for a 43-inch screen

placements.placement: Black metal rack right where the pantry counter ends, about 55 cm wide and 1.85 m tall
placements.why: Holds the fridge and oven in one footprint and makes the kitchen one continuous run

placements.placement: On the rack’s raised base (about 12 cm off the floor, on castors)
placements.why: Easier to reach and to clean under. Roll it out to defrost

placements.placement: On the rack shelf above the fridge, at about chest height
placements.why: Off the counter, with an air gap above the fridge for ventilation

placements.placement: On the counter between the prep area and the rack end
placements.why: Away from the sink splash, close to the counter plug points

placements.placement: 2 white-gloss wall cabinets over the counter, from the RO purifier to the wardrobe end, with a warm light strip underneath
placements.why: Storage for dishes, dry food and guest supplies. Matches the existing base units

placements.placement: Both stay where they are in your photos: the AC above the balcony door, the outdoor unit on the balcony right of the door, and the RO on the wall above the sink
placements.why: No re-plumbing or AC gas work needed

placements.placement: Moved about 50 cm toward the window, swapping places with the fridge
placements.why: The kitchen side stays kitchen and the bedroom side stays bedroom. The mirror now faces the bed area

placements.placement: On the window side of the bed, with a lamp
placements.why: The left side of the bed is the walkway

placements.placement: Your wall-mounted folding desk (wood top, black brackets) on the left wall where the TV used to be, with the dark chair and a round mirror above
placements.why: Folds flat against the wall when not in use. Plug points are already on that wall. The mirror also works as a dressing mirror

placements.placement: In the entry, beside the door
placements.why: Bags stay out of the room

placements.placement: Top-load machine on the right end of the balcony, on a raised stand
placements.why: Leaves the sliding door and the rest of the balcony clear. The stand keeps it off a wet floor

shoppingList.spec: Double comforter + 2 covers, 2 king fitted sheet sets
2 modular wall cabinets, about 1.15 m × 0.7 m, white gloss, LED strip
Metal fridge base on castors + microwave shelf (one combined unit)
Mattress joiner strip + 2 bed connecting brackets
Blackout pair + sheer panel, rod for the window
Ceramic base, linen shade, warm bulb
Under the TV, for the router and decor
Raised stand with wheels, waterproof cover
Wall ledge above the TV, about 1 m, matching finish, 4 small pots of flowering plants
